verdict.rationale: Runtime probes show Reclaim's first-party MCP endpoint is auth-gated with MCP-spec OAuth. Its RFC 9728 discovery document advertises coarse 'read', 'write' and 'mcp' scopes, so an agent could plausibly be granted a read-only, scoped token. However, no vendor documentation describes this, and there is no evidence of user-facing controls for issuing, scoping or revoking agent credentials. Missing for 10: first-party docs on credential scoping, fine-grained per-resource scopes, a user-facing token/API-key management UI with revocation, and hands-on confirmation that the scopes are actually enforced.
